arxiv-1803-05111.title: Photoinduced High-Frequency Charge Oscillations in Dimerized Systems
arxiv-1803-05111.creator: Kenji Yonemitsu
arxiv-1803-05111.description: Abstract Photoinduced charge dynamics in dimerized systems is studied on the basis of the exact diagonalization method and the time-dependent Schrödinger equation for a one-dimensional spinless-fermion model at half filling and a two-dimensional model for κ \kappa -(bis[ethylenedithio]tetrathiafulvalene) 2 X [ κ \kappa -(BEDT-TTF) 2 X] at three-quarter filling.

arxiv-2111-02339.title: CFTP/21-013 Prescription for finite oblique parameters S S and U U in extensions of the SM with m W ≠ m Z ​ cos ⁡ ( θ W ) m_{W}\neq m_{Z}\cos{\theta_W}
arxiv-2111-02339.creator: Francisco Albergaria, Luís Lavoura
arxiv-2111-02339.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Francisco Albergaria, Luís Lavoura. We consider extensions of the Standard Model with neutral scalars in multiplets of S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) SU(2) larger than doublets. When those scalars acquire vacuum expectation values, the resulting masses of the gauge bosons W ± W^{\pm} and Z 0 Z^{0} are not related by m W = m Z ​ cos ⁡ ( θ W ) m_{W}=m_{Z}\cos{\theta_W} .

arxiv-2206-08459.title: The Atari Disk, a Metal-Poor Stellar Population in the Disk System of the Milky Way Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2206-08459.creator: Mohammad K. Mardini, Anna Frebel, Anirudh Chiti, Yohai Meiron, Kaley V. Brauer, Xiaowei Ou
arxiv-2206-08459.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mohammad K. Mardini, Anna Frebel, Anirudh Chiti, Yohai Meiron, Kaley V. Brauer, Xiaowei Ou. We have developed a chemo-dynamical approach to assign 36,010 metal-poor SkyMapper stars to various Galactic stellar populations. Using two independent techniques (velocity and action space behavior), G ​ a ​ i ​ a Gaia EDR3 astrometry, and photometric metallicities, we selected stars with the characteristics of the ”metal-weak” thick disk population by minimizing contamination by the canonical thick disk or other Galactic structures.

arxiv-2306-10846.title: Transience of continuous-time conservative random walks
arxiv-2306-10846.creator: Satyaki Bhattacharya, Stanislav Volkov
arxiv-2306-10846.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Satyaki Bhattacharya, Stanislav Volkov. We consider two continuous-time generalizations of conservative random walks introduced in [ 10 , Englander and Volkov (2022)] , an orthogonal and a spherically symmetrical one; the latter model is also known as random flights .

arxiv-2310-17095.title: Evolution of Fullerenes in Circumstellar Envelopes by Carbon Condensation: Insights from Reactive Molecular Dynamics Simulations
arxiv-2310-17095.creator: Zhisen Meng, Zhao Wang
arxiv-2310-17095.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zhisen Meng, Zhao Wang. Fullerenes, including C 60 \text{C}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{60}}} and C 70 \text{C}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{70}}} , have been detected in various astronomical environments. Understanding how their structures evolve over time is essential for gaining insights into their life cycle and making further observations. To address this, we conducted reactive molecular dynamics simulations to investigate the evolution of fullerenes in the circumstellar envelopes surrounding carbon-rich asymptotic giant branch stars. Our simulations employed a bottom-up chemistry scheme, wherein fullerenes grow by absorbing and condensing small carbon-based molecules.

arxiv-2311-08308.title: The Heat is On: Thermal Facial Landmark Tracking
arxiv-2311-08308.creator: James Baker
arxiv-2311-08308.description: Abstract Facial landmark tracking for thermal images requires tracking certain important regions of subjects’ faces, using images from thermal images, which omit lighting and shading, but show the temperatures of their subjects. The fluctuations of heat in particular places reflect physiological changes like bloodflow and perspiration, which can be used to remotely gauge things like anxiety and excitement.

arxiv-2403-09895.title: Overcoming the cohesive zone limit in the modelling of composites delamination with TUBA cohesive elements Journal: Composites Part A: Applied Science and Manufacturing
arxiv-2403-09895.creator: Giorgio Tosti Balducci, Boyang Chen
arxiv-2403-09895.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Giorgio Tosti Balducci, Boyang Chen. The wide adoption of composite structures in the aerospace industry requires reliable numerical methods to account for the effects of various damage mechanisms, including delamination. Cohesive elements are a versatile and physically representative way of modelling delamination. However, using their standard form which conforms to solid substrate elements, multiple elements are required in the narrow cohesive zone, thereby requiring an excessively fine mesh and hindering the applicability in practical scenarios.

arxiv-2404-03883.title: LiDAR-Guided Cross-Attention Fusion for Hyperspectral Band Selection and Image Classification
arxiv-2404-03883.creator: Judy X Yang, , Jun Zhou, , Jing Wang, , Hui Tian, , and Alan Wee-Chung Liew
arxiv-2404-03883.description: Abstract The fusion of hyperspectral and LiDAR data has been an active research topic. Existing fusion methods have ignored the high-dimensionality and redundancy challenges in hyperspectral images, despite that band selection methods have been intensively studied for hyperspectral image (HSI) processing.

arxiv-2406-03896.title: Data-driven discovery of self-similarity using neural networks
arxiv-2406-03896.creator: Ryota Watanabe, Takanori Ishii, Yuji Hirono, Hirokazu Maruoka
arxiv-2406-03896.description: Abstract Finding self-similarity is a key step for understanding the governing law behind complex physical phenomena. Traditional methods for identifying self-similarity often rely on specific models, which can introduce significant bias. In this paper, we present a novel neural network-based approach that discovers self-similarity directly from observed data, without presupposing any models.

arxiv-2412-05574.title: Rate-Distortion Optimized Skip Coding of Region Adaptive Hierarchical Transform Coefficients for MPEG G-PCC
arxiv-2412-05574.creator: Zehan Wang, Yuxuan Wei, Hui Yuan Wei Zhang, Peng Li
arxiv-2412-05574.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zehan Wang, Yuxuan Wei, Hui Yuan Wei Zhang, Peng Li. Three-dimensional (3D) point clouds are becoming more and more popular for representing 3D objects and scenes. Due to limited network bandwidth, efficient compression of 3D point clouds is crucial. To tackle this challenge, the Moving Picture Experts Group (MPEG) is actively developing the Geometry-based Point Cloud Compression (G-PCC) standard, incorporating innovative methods to optimize compression, such as the Region-Adaptive Hierarchical Transform (RAHT) nestled within a layer-by-layer octree-tree structure.

arxiv-2502-12635.title: Corrupted but Not Broken: Understanding and Mitigating the Negative Impacts of Corrupted Data in Visual Instruction Tuning
arxiv-2502-12635.creator: Yunhao Gou, Hansi Yang *, Zhili Liu, Kai Chen, Yihan Zeng, Lanqing Hong, Zhenguo Li, Qun Liu, Bo Han, James T. Kwok, Yu Zhang
arxiv-2502-12635.description: Abstract Visual Instruction Tuning (VIT) aims to enhance Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), yet its effectiveness is often compromised by corrupted datasets with issues such as hallucinated content, incorrect responses, and poor OCR quality. Previous approaches to address these challenges have focused on refining datasets through high-quality data collection or rule-based filtering that can be costly or limited in scope.

arxiv-2503-01995.title: The Infrared-Bright SW Knots in the Complex Ejecta of VY CMa
arxiv-2503-01995.creator: Roberta M. Humphreys, Terry J. Jones, Kris Davidson, A. M. S. Richards, R. Ravi, A. P. Singh, L. M. Ziurys
arxiv-2503-01995.description: Abstract The red hypergiant VY CMa is remarkable for its very visible record of high mass loss events observed over the range of wavelengths from the optical and infrared to the submillimeter region with ALMA. The SW Clump or SW knots are unique in the ejecta of VY CMa.

arxiv-2507-11222.title: An Agentic Flow for Finite State Machine Extraction using Prompt Chaining PubID: pubid: 979-8-3315-0185-3/25/$31.00 ©2025 IEEE
arxiv-2507-11222.creator: 1 st Fares Wael, 2 nd Youssef Maklad, 3 rd Ali Hamdi, 4 th Wael Elsersy
arxiv-2507-11222.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by 1 st Fares Wael, 2 nd Youssef Maklad, 3 rd Ali Hamdi, 4 th Wael Elsersy. Finite-State Machines (FSMs) are critical for modeling the operational logic of network protocols, enabling verification, analysis, and vulnerability discovery. However, existing FSM extraction techniques face limitations such as scalability, incomplete coverage, and ambiguity in natural language specifications.

pmc-11313608.title: Influential Factors on Diffusion Bonding Strength as Demonstrated by Bonded Multi-Layered Stainless Steel 316L and 430 Stack
pmc-11313608.creator: Da-Wei Liu, Chun-Nan Lin, Wei-Shuai Lin, Shyong Lee, Jyh Gwo, Andrea Di Schino
pmc-11313608.description: In this study, we optimized the parameters of diffusion bonding on multi-layered stainless steel 316L and 430 stacks. The preparation process for diffusion bonding is crucial, as the bonding surfaces need to be polished and meticulously cleaned to ensure a smooth bonding process.

pmc-11437456.title: N-Acetylcysteine Inhibits Coxsackievirus B3 Replication by Downregulating Eukaryotic Translation Elongation Factor 1 Alpha 1
pmc-11437456.creator: Yao Wang, Tian Luan, Lixin Wang, Danxiang Feng, Yanyan Dong, Siwei Li, Hong Yang, Yang Chen, Yanru Fei, Lexun Lin, Jiahui Pan, Zhaohua Zhong, Wenran Zhao, Chaoping Chen, Andreas Jekle
pmc-11437456.description: Group B Coxsackieviruses (CVB) are one of the causative pathogens of myocarditis, which may progress to cardiomyopathy. The pathogenesis of CVB is not fully understood, and effective antiviral therapy is not available. N-acetylcysteine (NAC), the classic antioxidant, has been used in clinical practice for several decades to treat various medical conditions.

pmc-11551486.title: The initiative for consensus and standards in pig-to-human xenotransplantation in China
pmc-11551486.creator: Dong Niu, Yulong Yin
pmc-11551486.description: us and standards for xenotransplantation using genetically modified pigs to benefit patients worldwide. The necessity of xenotransplantation In China, thousands of patients await organ transplants each year, but severe donor shortages often lead to a long wait or even death. This critical supply-demand imbalance necessitates urgent solutions.

pmc-12681416.title: Mesenteric Venous Malformation With Subocclusive Symptoms: A Case Report
pmc-12681416.creator: Joseph Amara, Elio Mikhael, Santa El Helou, Jad Hachem, Rita Slim, César Yaghi
pmc-12681416.description: Venous malformations, previously referred to as cavernous hemangiomas, can affect the gastrointestinal tract and rarely the mesentery. When symptomatic, it can cause pain, hematochezia, or less frequently obstructive symptoms. In this paper, we report the case of a 60-year-old man who presented to the emergency department for abdominal pain and subocclusive symptoms.

pmc-12995746.title: Evidence of goose circovirus identified in Muscovy ducks
pmc-12995746.creator: Mengyan Zhang, Youlin Chen, Zhongjun Tian, Yu Huang, Chunhe Wan, Guangwen Yin, Ye Chen
pmc-12995746.description: Goose circovirus (GoCV) has been found in waterfowl more than 20 years, causing considerable economic loss worldwide. In the present study, goose circovirus (designated DuGoCV) was identified in Muscovy ducks in China, with complete genomes were sequenced and analyzed. The genetic evolutionary characteristics and recombination patterns of different genotypes were examined. The DuGoCV strain shared genome sequence identities of 89.2–95.

pmc-13064696.title: Melatonin dose and timing: Do we have it right?
pmc-13064696.creator: Shobha George, Anushree Sripathy, Aysha Rehman, Joseph George, Kanishk Chirayil, Emma Frost, Nalini Ramanathan, Simy Joseph, Karim Ghobrial-Sedky, Akshay Sripathy, Jose Maldonado, Jeff McCagh, Maju Mathew Koola
pmc-13064696.description: Melatonin is an easily accessible, widely used drug for sleep issues, disrupted sleep–wake cycles, and jet lag, available in a variety of forms and dosages. Melatonin is also used in hospital settings to promote sleep onset, particularly in elderly patients, as a circadian rhythm regulator.

pmc-13546718.title: Molecular characterization of peste des petits ruminants virus in small ruminants from the Savannah District, Northern Ivory Coast
pmc-13546718.creator: Konan Ange-Sylvestre Goli, Aristide Anicet Zobo, Augustino Alfred Chengula, Melvyn Quan, Benjamin Kiffopan M’Bari, Mariam Makange, Jean Nepomuscene Hakizimana, Peter Thompson, Gerald Misinzo

pmc-13663237.title: “Let my mother come and may it smell like strawberries”: a qualitative study of illness experiences in school-age children with cancer (6–12 years)
pmc-13663237.creator: Sibel Dağliyar, Emine Güdek Seferoğlu
pmc-13663237.description: BackgroundChildren diagnosed with cancer experience a complex process that affects their physical, emotional, and social well-being. Understanding these experiences from the child’s perspective is essential for delivering high-quality, child-centered nursing care. This study aimed to explore the illness experiences and future perceptions of school-age children (6–12 years) with cancer through their narratives and creative expressions.
